description: Cross-engine contract for task-prompts LOAD validation beyond the transcript schema (currently: the duplicate item-id refusal). Each case's `jsonl` lines are the file's raw JSONL rows, fed to the engine's task-prompt loader; `expect` is the EXACT refusal message (null = the file loads). Item numbers in messages are 1-based ordinals in the parsed item list, identical on both engines. Both engines' tests replay every case: Swift ExperimentTasks.parseTaskPrompts (Tests/ExperimentKitTests/TaskPromptDuplicateIDTests.swift), Python tasks._load_prompts (Server/tests/test_task_prompt_ids.py). A message change must land in BOTH engines and in this file, consciously. Cases use explicit ids only: auto-numbering conventions differ across engines (Swift 'prompt-<ordinal>' 1-based vs server 'prompt-<line index>' 0-based), so explicit/auto collisions are engine-local behavior, not contract.
